messages:
alec r: morning - follow-up from the KV cache incident last night. want clear owners/tiny timelines so this doesnt recur.
alec r: tl;dr: shard rebalancer + short TTLs caused cache churn -> redis alerts flapped -> multiple pagers. okay to track 4 quick actions here.
alec r: actions i propose (short):
  A) rebuild dedupe fingerprint logic for redis alerts (stop using ephemeral instance labels)
  B) increase sustain window for high-cardinality shard alerts and add exponential backoff on repeats
  C) change paging routing so brief spikes go to ops-queue not primary oncall
  D) run a 48h noise-monitor after deploy to catch regressions
please volunteer owner + ETA (date or "tomorrow EOD").
mira s: i'll take A. plan: replace `instance` with `shard`+`metric` fingerprint, add unit test that replays churn. ETA: Tue EOD (2023-11-14).
ben p: i'll pick B. my note: prefer `for: 45s` -> `for: 120s` and add alert-level rate limiter: block re-pages of same dedupe_key for 10m. ETA: today afternoon (2023-11-12).
kyle_h: i'll do C (paging routing). proposal: route to #ops-queue for severity=warning unless sustained >2m or errors>1.5% for 60s. will open PR for change in routing rules. ETA: Monday AM (2023-11-13).
ops-bot: Silence set by kyle_h for channel #pager-duty on 2023-11-12T10:45Z until 2023-11-13T08:00Z. Incident KV-2023-11-12 attached.
ben p: putting a quick config diff for B here:
```yaml
- alert: RedisShardHighMem
  expr: redis_mem_percent{shard=~"kv-.*"} > 88
  for: 120s
  labels:
    severity: warning
    dedupe_key: "{{ $labels.shard }}:{{ $metric }}"
```
ben p: the dedupe_key addition means duplicates across shards won't page repeatedly.
mira s: on A: i'll add a small replay harness `tools/alert_replay --fixture kv_churn.json` so maintainers can validate under synthetic churn.
alec r: thanks. can each owner paste a one-line ETA for me to drop into the PM tracker? i'll ping product if any customer notice needed.
mira s: ETA: Tue EOD (2023-11-14) - PR + tests.
ben p: ETA: 2023-11-12 EOD - config change + staging validation.
kyle_h: ETA: 2023-11-13 09:00 - routing PR and runbook update.
alec r: after deploy we'll run a quick 48h noise monitor. who can own the monitoring job and the follow-up report?
ben p: i'll run the monitor and post a short summary at 24h and 48h.
ops-bot: Replay job scheduled: alert_replay:kv_churn by ben p in staging at 2023-11-12T15:00Z.
ben p: note: run `./scripts/alert-sim --rule RedisShardHighMem --repeat 300` to simulate flapping.
mira s: i'll validate dedupe fingerprint in staging before config flips. will report failures in this thread.
kyle_h: small ask: add a checklist item to the postmortem to review paging thresholds after 2 weeks. prevents drift.
alec r: will add that to PM tracker and set a calendar reminder. quick blockers?
mira s: none.
ben p: none.
kyle_h: none.
alec r: ok closing for now. i'll update the tracker with owners/ETAs and re-open if anything slips. thanks :thumbsup:
